$comment: Source of truth for card identity and Rider–Waite–Smith symbolism. Edit here, then run `npm run manifest` to regenerate prompts in art/manifest.json (production status fields are preserved). `scene` is plain description reused for alt text; `symbols` are the non-negotiable RWS elements checked at review.

major.name: The Fool
major.scene: A carefree young traveler steps toward the edge of a high cliff, face lifted to the sky, holding a white rose, a small bundle on a staff over one shoulder, a little white dog leaping at their heels beneath a radiant sun.
symbols: cliff edge with one foot stepping forward
white rose held aloft in the left hand
staff over the right shoulder with a small burgundy bundle
small white dog at the heels
radiant sun in the upper right
patterned tunic and laurel-wreathed cap with a single feather

major.name: The Magician
major.scene: A robed magician stands behind a stone table, one hand raising a double-tipped wand to the sky and the other pointing to the earth, an infinity sign glowing above their head and a cup, sword, pentacle and wand laid on the table, framed by roses and lilies.
symbols: right hand raising a double-tipped white wand skyward
left hand pointing down to the earth
golden infinity lemniscate above the head
belt of a serpent biting its own tail
table holding a cup, a sword, a pentacle and a wand
ivory inner robe with burgundy outer mantle
red roses overhead and white lilies in the foreground garden

major.name: The High Priestess
major.scene: A serene priestess in flowing blue and ivory robes sits between a dark pillar and a pale pillar, wearing a horned moon crown, a scroll half-hidden in her lap and a crescent moon at her feet, before a veil embroidered with pomegranates.
symbols: seated between a dark pillar on her right marked B and a pale pillar on her left marked J
horned crown cradling a full moon disc
equal-armed solar cross on her chest
partially concealed scroll in her lap
veil behind her embroidered with pomegranates and palm fronds
glimpse of still water beyond the veil

major.name: The Empress
major.scene: A crowned empress reclines on a cushioned throne in a lush garden, a heart-shaped shield bearing the Venus symbol beside her, golden wheat at her feet and a waterfall flowing from a cypress forest behind.
symbols: heart-shaped shield bearing the Venus symbol
ripe golden wheat in the foreground

major.name: The Emperor
major.scene: A stern bearded emperor sits on a stone throne carved with ram heads, armor beneath a burgundy robe, holding an ankh scepter and a golden orb before barren mountains.
symbols: stone throne carved with four ram heads
armor visible beneath a burgundy robe
ankh-topped scepter in the right hand
golden orb in the left hand
rugged barren mountains behind with a thin stream at their base

major.name: The Hierophant
major.scene: A robed spiritual teacher in a triple crown sits between two grey pillars, one hand raised in blessing and the other holding a triple cross, crossed keys at their feet and two acolytes kneeling before them.
symbols: triple-barred cross staff in the left hand
two crossed keys at the feet
two kneeling tonsured acolytes, one robed with roses and one with lilies

major.name: The Lovers
major.scene: A winged angel spreads its arms above the clouds before a radiant sun, blessing a man and a woman who stand below, a fruit tree with a coiled serpent behind her and a tree of flames behind him, a mountain peak rising between them.
symbols: winged angel in the clouds with arms outstretched
man and woman standing below, classically draped
tree with fruit and a coiled serpent behind the woman
tree bearing twelve flames behind the man
single mountain peak between the figures
major.notes: RWS depicts the figures nude; this deck drapes them in ivory cloth for an all-ages app. Recorded as an intentional deviation.

major.name: The Chariot
major.scene: An armored charioteer stands in a stone chariot beneath a star-spangled canopy, a black sphinx and a white sphinx resting before it, a walled city and river behind.
symbols: armored charioteer holding a wand-like scepter, no reins
one black sphinx and one white sphinx before the chariot
winged disc emblem on the chariot front

major.name: Strength
major.scene: A gentle woman in an ivory robe crowned with flowers calmly closes the jaws of a lion, an infinity sign glowing above her head, mountains behind.
symbols: woman gently closing a lion's jaws with bare hands
golden infinity lemniscate above her head
wreath of flowers in her hair and a belt of roses

major.name: The Hermit
major.scene: A cloaked grey-bearded elder stands alone on a snowy mountain peak at night, holding up a lantern that contains a shining six-pointed star and leaning on a tall staff.
symbols: grey-bearded elder in a hooded grey cloak
lantern raised in the right hand containing a six-pointed star
tall staff in the left hand

major.name: Wheel of Fortune
major.scene: A great golden wheel inscribed with alchemical symbols turns in the clouds, a sphinx with a sword seated on top, a serpent descending one side and a jackal-headed figure rising on the other, four winged creatures reading books in the corners.
symbols: large golden wheel with eight spokes and alchemical symbols (no lettering)
sphinx holding a sword seated atop the wheel
jackal-headed figure rising on the right
four winged creatures in the corners on clouds: angel, eagle, lion and bull, each reading a book
major.notes: RWS inscribes TARO/ROTA and Hebrew letters on the wheel; omitted under the no-text rule, alchemical glyphs retained.

major.name: Justice
major.scene: A crowned figure in a burgundy robe sits between two stone pillars, holding an upright double-edged sword in one hand and balanced golden scales in the other, a veil hanging behind.
symbols: upright double-edged sword in the right hand
balanced scales in the left hand
burgundy robe with a green-teal cape
seated between two grey stone pillars
one white shoe peeking from beneath the robe

major.name: The Hanged Man
major.scene: A serene man hangs upside down by one foot from a living T-shaped tree, his other leg bent behind to form a cross, hands behind his back and a golden halo around his head.
symbols: suspended upside down by the right foot
left leg bent behind the right knee forming a cross
calm face surrounded by a golden halo

major.name: Death
major.scene: A skeletal knight in dark armor rides a white horse carrying a black banner marked with a white rose, a fallen king beneath the hooves, a bishop, a maiden and a child before it, the sun rising between two towers on the horizon.
symbols: skeleton in dark armor riding a white horse
black banner bearing a white five-petaled rose

major.name: Temperance
major.scene: A winged angel in an ivory robe pours water between two cups, one foot on land and one in a pool, irises blooming beside them and a path winding to mountains crowned with light.
symbols: winged angel pouring water between two golden cups
one foot in the water and one on land
triangle within a square on the robe
path leading to mountains with a crown of light

major.name: The Devil
major.scene: A horned, bat-winged devil with goat features crouches on a dark pedestal, one hand raised and the other holding a lowered torch, a horned man and woman loosely chained to the pedestal below.
symbols: horned goat-featured figure with bat wings
lowered torch in the left hand
dark square pedestal with a ring
horned man and woman with tails, loosely chained by the neck, classically draped
major.notes: RWS figures are nude; draped here. Keep the devil stylized and ornamental rather than gory.

major.name: The Tower
major.scene: A tall stone tower on a rocky crag is struck by lightning at night, its crown blasted from the top, flames bursting from the windows and two figures falling headlong.
symbols: tall stone tower on a jagged crag
twenty-two small golden flame drops in the air

major.name: The Star
major.scene: A kneeling woman pours water from two jugs, one into a still pool and one onto the land, beneath a great eight-pointed star circled by seven smaller stars, an ibis perched in a tree behind.
symbols: kneeling woman with one knee on land and one foot in the pool, classically draped
pouring from two jugs: one into the pool, one onto land in five streams
major.notes: RWS figure is nude; draped here.

major.name: The Moon
major.scene: A full moon with a crescent and a solemn face sheds drops of light over a dog and a wolf howling beside a pool, a crayfish emerging from the water and a path winding between two towers toward distant mountains.
symbols: full moon with crescent and a face in profile

major.name: The Sun
major.scene: A radiant sun with a calm face shines over a joyful child riding a white horse, arms spread wide and holding a burgundy banner, sunflowers peeking over a garden wall behind.
symbols: large radiant sun with a face
naked-armed joyful child on a white horse, wearing a flower wreath and a red feather
four sunflowers over a stone garden wall

major.name: Judgement
major.scene: A great angel in the clouds blows a trumpet hung with a banner bearing a red cross, while grey figures rise from open coffins below with arms outstretched, mountains and sea behind.
symbols: angel in the clouds blowing a golden trumpet
banner with an equal-armed red cross
figures rising from coffins with arms raised
man, woman and child in the foreground

major.name: The World
major.scene: A dancing figure wrapped in a flowing sash holds two wands inside a great laurel wreath bound with ribbons, with an angel, an eagle, a lion and a bull watching from the four corners.
symbols: dancing figure wrapped in a flowing burgundy sash, classically draped
a slender wand in each hand
burgundy ribbons tied top and bottom in infinity loops
angel, eagle, lion and bull heads in the four corners on clouds

wands.emblem: living wooden wands sprouting green leaves

cards.scene: A hand emerges from a cloud grasping a sprouting wooden wand, leaves drifting down, a castle on a hill in the distance.
A man in a burgundy cloak stands on castle battlements holding a small globe and a wand, gazing out over sea and land, a second wand fixed to the wall.
symbols: man holding a globe in the right hand
one wand held, one wand fixed to the battlement
castle battlement overlooking sea and land
emblem of crossed roses and lilies on the wall

cards.scene: A figure seen from behind stands on a cliff beside three planted wands, watching ships sail across a golden sea.
symbols: figure seen from behind on a cliff top
three wands planted in the ground, one held
ships sailing on the sea below

cards.scene: Four wands hung with a garland of flowers and fruit form a canopy, two figures raising bouquets in celebration before a castle.
symbols: four upright wands joined by a garland of flowers and fruit

cards.scene: Five young figures brandish wands at one another in a spirited mock battle on open ground.
symbols: five figures each holding a wand
open ground under a clear sky

cards.scene: A laurel-crowned rider on a white horse carries a wand topped with a wreath through a crowd raising their own wands.
symbols: laurel wreath on the rider's head
wand topped with a laurel wreath

cards.scene: A determined figure on high ground fends off six wands rising from below with a single wand, wearing mismatched shoes.
symbols: figure on a hilltop holding one wand defensively

cards.scene: Eight wands fly in parallel through the air over open countryside with a river and a hill.
symbols: eight wands flying diagonally in parallel

cards.scene: A weary figure with a bandaged head leans on a wand, eight more wands standing behind like a palisade.
symbols: eight wands standing behind like a fence

cards.scene: A figure bends forward under the weight of ten wands carried in a bundle toward a distant town.
symbols: figure carrying ten wands in a heavy bundle
bent posture, face hidden behind the wands

cards.scene: A youth in a feathered cap and a tunic patterned with salamanders holds a tall wand, studying it in a desert with distant pyramids.
symbols: youth holding a tall sprouting wand

cards.scene: A knight in armor and a salamander-patterned tunic rides a rearing horse, wand raised, distant pyramids behind.
A queen sits on a lion-carved throne holding a wand and a sunflower, a black cat seated at her feet.
symbols: queen holding a wand in the right hand
sunflowers and lions on the throne back

cards.scene: A king on a throne decorated with lions and salamanders holds a flowering wand, a small salamander at his feet.
symbols: throne back decorated with lions and salamanders
small living salamander at his feet

cards.scene: A hand emerges from a cloud holding a chalice that overflows in five streams into a lily pond, a dove descending with a wafer toward the cup.
symbols: descending dove carrying a wafer marked with an equal-armed cross

cards.scene: A young man and woman exchange cups and pledge, a caduceus crowned with a winged lion's head rising between them.
symbols: man and woman each holding a cup, facing each other
winged lion's head above the caduceus

cards.scene: Three women dance in a circle raising their cups in a garden full of harvest fruit.
symbols: three women raising cups in a toast
harvest of fruits and gourds at their feet

cards.scene: A young man sits beneath a tree with arms crossed, contemplating three cups before him while a hand from a cloud offers a fourth.
symbols: seated figure under a tree with arms crossed
hand from a cloud offering a fourth cup

cards.scene: A figure in a dark cloak mourns over three spilled cups while two upright cups stand behind, a bridge leading across a river to a castle.
symbols: figure in a long dark cloak, head bowed
river with a bridge leading to a castle

cards.scene: In an old village courtyard a child offers a cup filled with white flowers to a smaller child, six flower-filled cups around them.
symbols: child offering a cup of white flowers to a smaller child
six cups filled with white flowers
guard walking away in the background

cards.scene: A figure seen in silhouette faces seven cups floating on clouds, each holding a vision: a castle, jewels, a laurel wreath, a dragon, a serpent, a veiled glowing figure and a head.
symbols: figure in silhouette seen from behind
visions: castle, jewels, laurel wreath, dragon, serpent, veiled glowing figure, a head

cards.scene: A cloaked figure with a staff walks away from eight neatly stacked cups toward rocky mountains under a crescent moon embracing a sun.
symbols: cloaked figure walking away with a staff
eight stacked cups with a gap in the top row
crescent moon within a solar disc in the sky

cards.scene: A contented man sits with arms crossed before a curved, cloth-draped bench holding nine cups in an arc.
symbols: satisfied man seated with arms crossed
nine cups arranged in an arc behind him
curved bench draped in blue cloth

cards.scene: A couple raises their arms toward a rainbow of ten cups while two children dance, a cottage by a river behind them.
symbols: couple with arms raised in joy

cards.scene: A youth in a floral tunic stands by the sea holding a cup from which a small fish peeks out.
symbols: small fish looking out of the cup

cards.scene: A knight in winged helmet rides a calm white horse at a walk, holding a cup forward, a river running through the valley.
symbols: knight on a calm white horse

cards.scene: A queen sits on a throne at the sea's edge carved with cherubs, gazing into an ornate closed chalice.
symbols: queen holding an ornate lidded chalice
throne carved with cherubs and a scallop shell

cards.scene: A king on a throne floating on a choppy sea holds a cup and a scepter, a ship and a leaping fish nearby.
symbols: king holding a cup and a short scepter

swords.emblem: straight double-edged swords with gilded hilts

cards.scene: A hand emerges from a cloud holding an upright sword whose tip passes through a golden crown hung with olive and palm, above jagged mountains.
symbols: olive branch and palm frond hanging from the crown

cards.scene: A blindfolded woman sits on a stone bench with arms crossed over her chest, holding two swords, a rocky sea and crescent moon behind her.
symbols: two swords crossed over her chest

cards.scene: A heart pierced by three swords hangs against storm clouds and slanting rain.
The effigy of a knight lies on a tomb in a quiet chapel, hands joined in prayer, three swords on the wall above and one along the tomb, a stained-glass window nearby.
symbols: knight effigy lying on a tomb, hands in prayer
three swords hanging point-down on the wall
one sword lying along the tomb

cards.scene: A smirking figure gathers swords while two defeated figures walk away toward the sea under a torn, windy sky.
A ferryman poles a boat carrying a cloaked woman and child toward a calm far shore, six swords standing upright in the boat.
symbols: six swords upright in the boat
rough water on one side, calm on the other

cards.scene: A figure tiptoes away from a camp of tents carrying five swords, glancing back at two swords left planted in the ground.
symbols: figure sneaking away carrying five swords

cards.scene: A bound and blindfolded woman stands in marshy ground surrounded by eight swords, a castle on a cliff behind.
A figure sits up in bed with face buried in their hands, nine swords stacked horizontally on the dark wall, a quilt patterned with roses and astrological signs.
symbols: figure sitting up in bed, face in hands
nine swords horizontal on a dark wall
quilt patterned with roses and zodiac signs

cards.scene: A figure lies face down pierced by ten swords beneath a dark sky, while dawn breaks gold over still water on the horizon.
symbols: figure lying face down with ten swords in the back
golden dawn breaking on the horizon

cards.scene: A youth stands on a windswept hill holding a sword upright with both hands, birds scattering through billowing clouds.
symbols: youth holding an upright sword with both hands

cards.scene: A knight charges at full gallop on a white horse, sword raised, through wind-bent trees and racing clouds.
symbols: birds and butterflies on the harness

cards.scene: A queen sits in profile on a throne carved with butterflies, holding an upright sword with one hand and extending the other, a single bird high in the sky.
symbols: queen in profile holding an upright sword
throne carved with butterflies and a winged cherub

cards.scene: A king sits facing forward on a throne carved with butterflies, holding an upright sword slightly tilted, cypress trees and birds behind.
symbols: king facing forward holding an upright sword
throne back with butterflies and crescent moons

pentacles.emblem: golden discs engraved with a five-pointed star

cards.scene: A hand emerges from a cloud holding a great golden pentacle above a garden of lilies, a hedge archway opening onto distant mountains.
A young man in a tall hat dances while juggling two pentacles bound by an infinity loop, ships riding high waves behind him.
symbols: young figure in a tall hat juggling two pentacles
infinity loop ribbon around the pentacles

cards.scene: A stonemason on a bench works in a cathedral arch while a monk and a robed patron hold plans and confer, three pentacles carved in the arch.
symbols: stonemason on a workbench in an archway
monk and patron holding architectural plans
three pentacles carved in the arch

cards.scene: A crowned figure sits clutching a pentacle to their chest, another balanced on their crown and two beneath their feet, a city behind.
symbols: crowned figure clutching a pentacle to the chest
pentacle on top of the crown

cards.scene: Two ragged figures, one on crutches, trudge through falling snow past a glowing stained-glass window showing five pentacles.
symbols: one on crutches with a bandaged leg
lit stained-glass window with five pentacles

cards.scene: A merchant holding balanced scales gives coins to two kneeling figures, six pentacles floating around them.
symbols: giving coins to two kneeling figures

cards.scene: A farmer leans on a hoe gazing thoughtfully at seven pentacles growing on a leafy vine.
symbols: seven pentacles growing on a vine

cards.scene: A craftsman sits at a workbench carving a pentacle, finished pentacles hung on a post beside them, a town in the distance.
symbols: craftsman carving a pentacle with hammer and chisel
six finished pentacles displayed on a post

cards.scene: An elegant woman in a robe patterned with sunflowers stands in a lush vineyard with a hooded falcon on her gloved hand, nine pentacles among the vines.
symbols: elegant woman in a flowing robe with sunflower motifs
hooded falcon on her gloved hand

cards.scene: An elderly patriarch in a patterned robe sits beneath an archway with two white dogs, a couple and a child nearby, ten pentacles arranged across the scene.
symbols: elder in an ornate robe seated with two white dogs
couple and child under an archway
ten pentacles in the Tree of Life arrangement

cards.scene: A youth stands in a green field holding a pentacle up before their eyes, studying it, a ploughed field and trees behind.
symbols: youth holding a pentacle aloft and studying it

cards.scene: A knight sits motionless on a heavy black horse holding a pentacle, overlooking freshly ploughed fields.
symbols: knight on a still, heavy black horse
oak sprigs on the helmet and bridle

cards.scene: A queen sits on a throne carved with goat heads and fruit in a bower of roses, cradling a pentacle in her lap, a rabbit at her feet.
symbols: queen cradling a pentacle in her lap
throne carved with goat heads and fruit

cards.scene: A king in a robe patterned with grapevines sits on a bull-carved throne holding a pentacle and scepter, a castle behind.
symbols: king holding a pentacle and a scepter
robe patterned with grapes and vines
armored foot visible beneath the robe
